description:
An Instagram profile plus its most recent posts (up to 60) with type, caption, thumbnail and engagement counts where available.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: id (string), username (string), full_name (string), biography (string), external_url (string, nullable), profile_pic_url (string, nullable), profile_pic_url_hd (string, nullable), is_private (boolean), is_verified (boolean), is_business_account (boolean), category_name (string, nullable), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), post_count (integer, nullable), has_highlights (boolean, nullable), highlight_count (integer, nullable), posts (array<object>), posts_fetched (integer), posts_source (string), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return. Example: 12

username.description: Instagram username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "nasa"

name: instagram_photos
title: Instagram posts
